Hi Samir / Erin / Marissa,

Thanks for the note — happy to confirm details from the security/compliance side. Short answers up top, details below.

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering the Redwood Inference platform and hosted API (security, availability, confidentiality). The most recent Type II report period ended 2025-11-30 and the report was issued on 2026-01-15. We can provide a redacted copy for vendor review; let me know if Acme needs the full report or a redacted summary.

2) Roles (Controller / Processor): For typical hosted API customers like Acme where you send customer data to our API and we store/process it on your behalf, Acme is Controller and Redwood is Processor. The correct EU SCC module under the 2021 SCCs is Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). If Acme will export data to a third-party where Redwood is acting as a controller for that export, we can reevaluate.

3) Subprocessors: We publish a subprocessor list on our security portal and include it in the DPA. Any new subprocessor material changes are notified 30 days in advance. If Acme has specific objections to a subprocessors, we can discuss contractually.

4) DPA & editable files: Marissa uploaded the Word DPA to the Drive link; I also attached a redline-ready Word DPA to the shared folder. For quick turnaround, we can accept Acme redlines in Word or DocuSign redline PDF.

5) SCC specifics & recommended language: Module 2 language is the standard C2P template. For transfer mechanisms, if Acme requires SCC-only (no additional transfer tool), we confirm SCC Module 2 + standard SCC Annex(es). If Acme also requires UK transfers, we can provide UK Addendum language.

Next steps I suggest:
 - I’ll send a redacted SOC 2 Type II here (attached) to Erin for review (or provide access link to the portal).
 - Marissa to send a DocuSign link once Acme confirms they want to execute after redlines.
 - If helpful, schedule a 30-minute legal + security sync this week. I’m available Thu 2–4pm PST or Fri 9–11am PST.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Redacted.pdf, SCC-module-recommendation.xlsx, Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx (editable).

Happy to jump on a quick call if there are any specific control questions.
